Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
In substance, petitioner's grievance is that compensation for his land acquired under the Land Acquisition Act has not been released by the Collector.

A supplementary affidavit has also been filed annexing copy of the award passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer as per which the land was acquired on 03.06.2004 and declaration was issued on 04.07.2005.
There is nothing on record to show that petitioner has ever approached the Collector/Special Land Acquisition Officer in respect of his claim for receiving compensation.
The representations are made to various authorities except the competent authority.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The representations are made to various authorities except the competent authority.
In that view of the matter, we permit the petitioner to approach the concerned Collector/Special Land Acquisition Officer by way of a representation annexing therewith all materials in respect of his grievance, alongwith certified copy of this order, within a period of two weeks from today.
